target_customer: Teams deploying AI agents that take consequential actions such as refunds or payments and need human sign off
problem: Agents can take costly actions unchecked. withHuman holds tool calls, applies approval rules and routes hard cases to a human reviewer with an audit log.
business_model: Open core with a hosted version; core described as source available or open source

founders.name: Chris Battarbee
previous_startups: Metoro (AI SRE agent, YC S23 per Round Funded)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he was a Palantir software engineer building Foundry's compute platform.

technical_complexity.rationale: Intercepting agent tool calls, a rules engine, multi channel notifications and an open protocol with many framework adapters is standard engineering; SOC 2 Type II adds compliance work.

defensibility.rationale: Open protocol and source available core ease adoption and copying; value comes from integrations and audit logs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not yet known. A similar YC company, HumanLayer (listed as F24), targets the same wedge.

market_need_then: Agents taking real actions created need for approval gates; the founders say the approval step they built for their earlier AI SRE product became this concept (Dealroom).

branding.brand_signature: Tagline: the approval layer for AI agents
branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launch page and MCP directory listings exist; no merch found.

brand_strength.rationale: Clear descriptive tagline but a generic name close to HumanLayer and other human-in-the-loop names; little press found.

outcome_analysis: withHuman is active and very young. The YC page shows Summer 2023 batch but a 2026 founding year, and the founder's earlier company Metoro appears in the S23 batch elsewhere, so the batch and company history are inconsistent. No verified funding or exit exists, so no outcome story can be drawn yet.
notes: Unverified: Dealroom lists a 125K seed with no investors, one aggregator only. Metoro funding figures conflict across VCBacked and Nordic9 and belong to a different product. Co-founder Ece Kayan is named only by Dealroom, so not listed. YC page says batch Summer 2023 yet founded 2026, unresolved. No dated competitors identified for the founding period.
